details:
The default T-Pose animation provided by VRChat has multiple issues for FBT users, especially those using Chest Tracking.

This suggestion proposes for users to be able to apply a T-Pose animation globally onto their account, making all Humanoid avatars stand in that pose when the user chooses to Calibrate.

This would fix 3 main issues:

1. The default T-Pose animation has a bizarre hip offset that shifts your body a small degree to the left, fixed by using a custom animation without these offsets.

2. With chest tracking, T-Posing tends to raise and slightly rotate the chest tracker. With an A-Pose animation, the arms and shoulders are more relaxed, calibrating the chest tracker without squishing the spine afterward.

3. T-Posing requires a lot of space in both directions. Being able to calibrate with a tighter pose would be beneficial for those who need to stand in specific areas within their playspace to be able to have the arm span to T-Pose.

Ideally, this would be implemented by either assigning an animation asset from within the client, or assigning it within Unity. The secondary benefit of this suggestion is that it will work for every avatar, even those that you buy from the marketplace or otherwise didn’t upload yourself.
title: Global T-Pose Animation Override
